## Description {#details}

<p>Instrumentation based profiling lowering pass.</p>


<p>This pass lowers the profile instrumented code generated by FE or the IR based instrumentation pass.</p>


<p>Definition at line 25 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/transforms/include/llvm/transforms/instrumentation/instrprofiling-h">InstrProfiling.h</a>.</p>
